composition.change: a short hollow pale ivory-tan bone tube whistle with one squared notch and one finger hole, a thin brown leather cord loop through the far end

note: Sirus23 plan feature 34 (pack Prompt 37). Finished with process_card_art (headless GIMP 3, keyed, trimmed to 344x512). The paper INSIDE the closed cord loop is not border-connected, so the keyer left it opaque white; it was keyed afterwards with a PIL flood fill of that one enclosed region (13,849 px, fringe faded on the 200 to 250 ramp) and re-quantized to a 256-colour palette. One sample, Claude-reviewed; awaits the owner's gallery review.

candidates.verdict: on-model: one plain bone tube, squared notch, one finger hole, brown cord loop, no decoration (Claude-reviewed, no owner pick)
